_comment: Declared architecture: what each file IS, and which layer it belongs to.
Layers are ordered top (entry) to bottom (foundation). A dependency may point
DOWN or sideways; a dependency pointing UP is a layering leak and is drawn as a
violation. This file is the intent - edit it when the intent changes. The import
graph is the reality. Compare the two by hand; a delta between them is a bug in one.
Authored by Claude 2026-08-27, reviewed by a human - correct it freely.
